package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_network_calls_retry_loop_without_backoff: Layer: Network calls. Flag network retry loops that immediately retry and amplify load.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario571Positive(client *http.Client, url string) error {
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		resp, err := client.Get(url)
		if err == nil {
			_ = resp.Body.Close()
			return nil
		}
	}
	return http.ErrHandlerTimeout
}
